title: Watch New Year's Rockin' Eve 2026: How & Where to Stream
text:
Ring in 2026: How to Watch Dick Clark’s New Year’s Rockin’ Eve and the Times Square Ball Drop
As the clock ticks down to 2026, millions will be searching for the best way to celebrate the arrival of the new year. Whether gathering at local venues, hosting private parties, or enjoying a quiet night in, a central tradition for many is watching the iconic Times Square ball drop. This year, Dick Clark’s New Year’s Rockin’ Eve remains a cornerstone of New Year’s Eve television, offering live performances and a countdown to midnight.
Who Will Host the New Year’s Eve Celebration?
Fan-favorite Ryan Seacrest is set to return as host for the celebration closing out 2025, and he will be joined once again by Rita Ora. The dynamic duo will be on hand to engage with revelers in New York City and visitors as they collectively count down to 2026.
When and Where to Watch Dick Clark’s New Year’s Rockin’ Eve
Dick Clark’s New Year’s Rockin’ Eve will broadcast live on ABC beginning at 8 p.m. ET. This year’s broadcast is set to be the longest in the program’s history, continuing until 4 a.m. ET.
Streaming Options for Cord-Cutters
Unfortunately, those without cable subscriptions will not be able to livestream Dick Clark’s New Year’s Rockin’ Eve. However, the program will be available to stream the following day on Hulu. For those seeking a live audio experience, the broadcast can be tuned into on several iHeartRadio stations nationwide, including Z100 New York and KIIS-FM Los Angeles, as well as through the iHeartRadio app.
A Star-Studded Performer Lineup
The 2026 edition of Dick Clark’s New Year’s Rockin’ Eve boasts an impressive lineup of performers. Diana Ross will headline the event in New York City, with additional performances from Maren Morris, Little Big Town, and Ciara. The celebration extends beyond New York, with Mariah Carey, 50 Cent, and Demi Lovato performing live from Las Vegas. Meanwhile, Post Malone and Chappell Roan are anticipated to perform in Nashville and Kansas City, respectively.
Alternative Options for Watching the Times Square Ball Drop
While Dick Clark’s New Year’s Rockin’ Eve is an ABC exclusive, viewers have other options for witnessing the Times Square ball drop live. CNN’s New Year’s Eve Live, co-hosted by Andy Cohen and Anderson Cooper, is another popular choice for those seeking a comprehensive New Year’s Eve broadcast.
